newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quotes firm amid crude gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quotes firm amid crude gains.

text.p: Singapore bunker market indications were quoted within Friday's range but were expected to move higher later on Monday amid crude gains, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted between $123-$125, while 380-cst heard at $119-$121, within Friday's range of $121-$125 and $118-$121 respectively.
"Enquiries were not as strong as Friday's but may pick up later," said a major.
MDO was quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil at $215-$220, slightly lower from Friday's $208-$213 and $220-$223 respectively.
